title: draft door: carry the connector-action probe (flow_connector_action_unresolved) on the draft verdict
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

PR #35244 (card #35146) adds the build probe `flow_connector_action_unresolved`. It fires when a `connector_action` step names a connector or action that the runtime cannot dispatch. Unlike the other probes it reads no landed data: it asks the automation engine the same lookups the executor does. So it could judge a draft too.

#35146's Done-when asked that the draft door's verdict (#34766) carry the same findings. It does not today. The draft judgement answers gate issues (rule, path, hint), and a probe finding has another shape (code, fix, userMessage). Joining the two is a shape decision that PR #35244 did not take. Its PR body records this as an accepted deviation.

## Scope

- Run the connector lookup on a draft flow, and surface it on the draft door's verdict.
- Do this either by mapping the finding into the gate-issue shape or by giving the verdict a probe-findings member. Choose by what the draft door's consumers (Studio, the MCP draft tools) read today.
- Pin a draft flow naming an unknown connector action.

Blocked until #35244 merges.

## Origin

Contract review 6989419029 on PR #35244 (escalated to the seat), and the round-3 dev report 6991937289 on #34776.

Re-check: `git grep -n "flow_connector_action_unresolved" origin/main -- packages/metadata-protocol/src`
